body.name: One-mechanism affine rational family
body.construction:
Fix a terminal role state \(\rho=(\bar X,\bar C)\in\Omega(\mathcal P;Y,X,C)\) and a displayed finite directed trace
\[
 \pi:\rho_0=(X,C)\longrightarrow\rho_1\longrightarrow\cdots\longrightarrow\rho_m=\rho
\]
in which every edge is a legal bucket-intersection Rule--2 exchange in \(\Omega(\mathcal P;Y,X,C)\).  Define the value of each \(u\in W=X\mathbin{\dot\cup}C\) by \(a_u=x_u\) for \(u\in X\) and \(a_u=c_u\) for \(u\in C\); at a state \((\bar X_i,\bar C_i)\), use the restrictions \(\bar x_i=a|_{\bar X_i}\) and \(\bar c_i=a|_{\bar C_i}\).  Fix represented coordinates \(\mathcal M\in[\mathcal P]_{\mathsf M}\) and \(\mathcal G\in[\mathcal M]_{\mathsf G}\), and nested \(R_F\)-rooted C-forests \(F'\subsetneq F\) satisfying the terminal selected-hedge predicates for the entire terminal intervention \(\bar X\).  Fix \(\mathbf M_{\mathrm{base}}\in\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{rat,bin}}^+(\mathcal P)\) realizing the displayed graph \(\mathcal G\), choose one normalized local table \(\theta\) of \(\mathbf M_{\mathrm{base}}\), and fix a rational basis matrix \(R_T\) for its blockwise simplex-tangent space \(T\).  An admissible direction has the form \(v=R_Tq\).  For such a direction, define \(\mathbf M(t)\) by replacing \(\theta\) with \(\theta+t v\), while holding every other local table, every state space, and all directed, latent, and selection incidences fixed.
